name: Blackrock Blockade
summary: Marshal Marris is pressing the Blackrock Blockade east of Lake Everstill. Lakeshire's guard aims to starve out the Blackrock orcs and take their weapons.

sections.title: A War of Attrition
sections.body: Blackrock raiders in Redridge are pushing Alliance forces to their limits. Cut off from regular supply trains, their forward parties live off the hills. Marshal Marris knows even fierce orcs cannot keep fighting without food and steel.

sections.title: Severing the Forward Camps
sections.body: South of Stonewatch Keep, Blackrock camps lead the clan's advance. Lakeshire's defenders strike those camps to seize supplies and stolen weapons, weakening the orcs' fighting strength and morale.

faq.q: What is the goal of the Blackrock Blockade?
faq.answer: Lakeshire's guard aims to weaken the Blackrock camps south of Stonewatch Keep. By taking their food and weapons, the defenders hope to starve the orcs and blunt their advance into Redridge.
Marshal Marris, who commands Lakeshire's town guard, directs the effort to disrupt Blackrock supplies and defend Redridge.

faq.q: Where are these Blackrock encampments located?
faq.answer: The Blackrock camps lie in the eastern hills of Redridge Mountains, south of Stonewatch Keep and across the river from Lakeshire.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire relying on attrition rather than a direct assault?
faq.answer: Lakeshire's guard has too few soldiers and little help from Stormwind. The Blackrock orcs have pushed into Alliance lands and now lack supplies, so the guard seeks to wear them down rather than attack head-on.

faq.q: What weapons are being confiscated from the orcs?
faq.answer: Marshal Marris wants the weapons and supplies stored in the Blackrock camps seized, leaving the orcs without their tools of war.

faq.q: Are these orcs affiliated with Thrall's Horde?
faq.answer: No. The Blackrock orcs in Redridge belong to the renegade Dark Horde based at Blackrock Mountain. They reject Thrall's leadership and remain hostile to both the Alliance and the new Horde.

angles.text: Every weapon taken from the Blackrock vanguard buys Lakeshire time as it faces hostile armies with little aid from Stormwind.
In close fights with rugged Blackrock orcs, taking away their heavy cleavers and supplies is a basic part of frontier warfare.
